findings.summary: UNAVAILABLE features manually constructed in derive-mvp-features.ts use the derivation key hash as their payloadHash instead of hashing the actual feature payload, which will cause content hash verification failures.
findings.suggested_fix: Instead of setting payloadHash: derivationKey.replace("dk-", ""), call canonicalHash on the constructed DerivedFeatureV1 object, or preferably refactor to use assembleDerivedFeature for UNAVAILABLE features as well.

findings.summary: UNAVAILABLE features manually constructed in derive-mvp-features.ts omit pipelineRunId and codeVersion in their provenance.processRef, breaking pipeline traceability.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the inline processRef objects in computeUnavailableDerivationKey callers to correctly populate pipelineRunId with runId and codeVersion, or extract an assembleUnavailableFeature helper.
